name: SideNavItems

props.name: isSideNavExpanded
props.description: Property to indicate if the side nav container is open (or not). Use to keep local state and styling in step with the SideNav expansion state.

a11y.note: Carbon ships a11y behaviour per component; verify per screen

when_to_use: Use Carbon SideNavItems rather than building one.
when_not_to_use: Do not restyle off-token — propose a token instead.
